description: Interop vectors for CLINK language ports. A correct implementation MUST round-trip these. Do not invent NIP-44 or TLV encodings — match @shocknet/clink-sdk (and the NIP-44 version on the wire).

tlv.layout: type (1 byte) | length (1 byte) | value (length bytes)
notes: Length is a single byte (0–255), NOT 2-byte big-endian.
Tag numbers and meanings are fixed — do not swap pubkey/relay.

nip44_v2.conversation_key: HKDF-Extract(SHA-256, salt=UTF8("nip44-v2"), IKM=ECDH shared X coordinate)
nip44_v2.message_keys: HKDF-Expand(SHA-256, PRK=conversation_key, info=32-byte nonce, L=76) → chacha_key(32) | chacha_nonce(12) | hmac_key(32)
not: Do NOT use HMAC(key="nip44-v2", msg=sharedX) for the conversation key
Do NOT use ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD with a 12-byte salt/nonce layout
Do NOT use HKDF info strings like "nip44-v2-keys" or "nip44-v2-message-key"
